_about: Painted scenes for the rock hall. Plain or partial cues are described as painted; rejected auto-hooks are not shown.

fr_pierre_noun.hook: PYEHR sounds like pier: a little wooden PIER stands in a pan of water and touches a solid dressed STONE.
fr_pierre_noun.why: The pier is a jetty standing in water, so it is not a table. The stone is a solid block.

fr_terre_noun.hook: TEHR sounds like tear: a torn sack of EARTH spills dark soil, and a seedling pokes through the tear.
fr_terre_noun.why: Auto-hook used a crying tear, the wrong vowel. The rip in the sack matches TEHR.

fr_mine_noun.hook: A tabletop MINE: one short rock tunnel, one lit lantern, and one ore cart on rails. Said MEEN.
fr_mine_noun.why: Auto-hook's mean-looking dwarf is a stereotype and is not painted. Plain mine model; MEEN is the pronunciation, not a second gag.

fr_mineral_adj.hook: mee-nay-RAHL, like English mineral: a sparkling MINERAL cluster throws a small rainbow under the hall lamp.
fr_mineral_adj.why: Cognate kept, with the rainbow glint as the twist. The badger helper is not painted.

fr_sol_noun.hook: SOL sounds like sole: the geologist stands his boot's SOLE in a tray of dark SOIL, and one worm lifts its head.
fr_sol_noun.why: The adult geologist is the helper and stands the boot sole-down in the soil. His whole body belongs in this group.

fr_cristal_noun.hook: krees-TAHL, like English crystal, and TAHL is in TALL: a TALL purple CRYSTAL on a stand, with a teacup-sized mouse at its base.
fr_cristal_noun.why: Cognate plus TALL. One mouse touches the base of the crystal. It is the only animal.

fr_pendule_noun_m.hook: pahn-DEWL, like English pendulum: a PENDULUM swings in its own wooden frame, and one ladybird rides the bob.
fr_pendule_noun_m.why: Masculine pendulum, not the clock la pendule. Ladybird is the small twist.

fr_creuset_noun.hook: kreuh-ZEH: an orange cast-iron pot glows on a trivet as a CRUCIBLE, with one small steady flame under it.
fr_creuset_noun.why: Orange pot is the sound cue and the crucible. No coins and no person.
